# Moody Spurgeon MacPherson

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P33](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a funny-looking boy. He possesses a big, fat face paired with little blue eyes, and his ears stick out prominently like flaps.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Personality

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson aspires to become a minister, though he acknowledges that pursuing a career as a carpenter would likely be easier. He experiences self-doubt regarding his academic performance, notably feeling a strong apprehension that he will fail English history.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P20](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0020)_

## Traits

- presumed failing in English history  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028)</sub>

## Goals

- to be a minister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P20](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0020)</sub>

## History

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson once got into a fight with [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) after claiming that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) put on airs. He later attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and other [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) students to pursue higher education. After completing his studies at Queen's, he returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) following the commencement ceremonies.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P4](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P7](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P8](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P12](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), +96 more_
